Thanks — quick technical clarifications to include in the map and TIA draft (Sam / NexaTeam FYI):

- Edge cache behavior: by default we hold KV cache shards for 30 minutes across regional edges to speed up cold starts. If you require zero edge-residency, we can enable an onshore-only fallback path but there is a ~12–18% latency hit.
- Proxying/transit nodes: requests for customers in the EU may briefly transit a US control plane for telemetry aggregation. We can provide telemetry redaction and retention windows; control plane transit does not include content persistence.
- Escrow/bridging: if Nexa requires an escrowed routing log for auditing, we can deliver a redacted activity log on a monthly cadence (CSV) via secure Share. This is not standard but feasible — will require a procurement add-on.

I added inline comments to the XLSX (column: operational_note) for anything that should not live in a contract.
